description: This file contains utility functions for advanced tensor indexing in PyTorch, including shape string representation, dispatch checks for masked fill operations, and index information creation.

methods.name: shapes_as_str
methods.description: Converts a list of tensors into a comma-separated string of their shapes.

methods.name: canDispatchToMaskedFill
methods.description: Checks if a tensor and indices can be dispatched to a masked fill operation, returning a tuple of a boolean and a mask tensor.

methods.name: make_info
methods.description: Creates an AdvancedIndex object for a tensor based on provided index tensors, handling broadcasting and transposing as needed.
